kultivator.kehancuran_total.on: Total Destruction ON: with Mode Kehancuran, every block can be destroyed (bedrock, obsidian, portals, fluids, chests with their contents) except inside protected zones. Destroyed bedrock opens the void.
kultivator.kehancuran_total.off: Total Destruction OFF: the old rules apply (bedrock, obsidian, portals, fluids and blocks with storage are left alone).
kultivator.kehancuran_total.server_off: Total Destruction is disabled by the server.
kultivator.kehancuran_total.status: Total Destruction: %s · containers restored with contents: %s
kultivator.kehancuran_total.undo_full: Container save limit reached: %s more containers were left intact so their contents are not lost.
kultivator.kehancuran_total.restored_be: Restored: %s blocks, %s containers with their contents.
kultivator.kehancuran_total.permanent_be: Decree tiers 6-9 are permanent: destroyed chests and containers are lost with their contents.
kultivator.kehancuran_total.test.needs: The Total Destruction test needs your own Mode Kehancuran switch on (/kultivasi kehancuran nyala).
kultivator.kehancuran_total.test.no_undo: The Total Destruction test needs a restore window (kehancuranUndoMinutes above 0) so its site can be cleared.
kultivator.kehancuran_total.test.refused: No loaded ground ahead of you can hold the test site.
kultivator.kehancuran_total.test.zone: The test site would touch a protected zone; move somewhere else.
kultivator.kehancuran_total.test.site: Test site %1$s: %2$s blocks placed at %3$s %4$s %5$s; an r 3 bowl follows. Pulihkan clears all of it.
kultivator.kehancuran_total.test.info.ru: Next cast: Total Destruction %1$s · your Mode Kehancuran on: %2$s · allowed by the server: %3$s
kultivator.kehancuran_total.test.info.un: Containers saved for Pulihkan: %1$s (%2$s KiB) · limit %3$s containers / %4$s KiB · rim fluid settle: %5$s cells
